caption: The drawing depicts a wooden desk with an L-shaped design, rendered primarily in shades of reddish-brown and tan, with a grayish surface top. The desk features four turned legs with bulbous sections and tapering lower segments. The front of the desk includes three visible drawers: two rectangular ones on the right and a single, larger, slightly recessed drawer on the left, all with small round drawer pulls and ornate linear carvings. To the lower right of the main desk illustration, there is a detailed close-up of one drawer front, emphasizing the handle and carved ornamentation; this detail is colored in the same reddish-brown hue as the desk. At the very bottom right of the image, there is a faint, minimally sketched frontal view of the desk in tan lines without color fill. The composition is centered on a plain, off-white background, and the perspective is slightly angled to show both the front and left side of the desk.
